disclaimer: Verification commands are contextualized for this finding; run active checks strictly within authorized scope.

secrets.title: Revoke and rotate leaked secret
secrets.summary: Exposed credentials, API keys or passwords found in ({docs}) must be treated as compromised and rotated immediately.

steps.title: Revoke and rotate the credential immediately
steps.action: Revoke the token or reset the password at the issuing system (IdP, cloud, DB, RDP/ICA) and audit authentication logs for unauthorized access.

steps.title: Purge secret from published files and VCS history
steps.action: Remove or redact the credential in ({docs}) hosted on {host}; if committed to Git, purge history cleanly.

steps.title: Enforce pre-publish secret scanning
steps.action: Enable pre-commit secret scanning and store credentials in a dedicated secret vault instead of files or client JS.

verify: Verify {url} returns 404/403 or redacted copy and old credential fails authentication.
Re-running FOCA-rs Preflight on updated artifacts reports zero secrets.

doc-sanitize.title: Sanitize document metadata, hidden layers and incremental revisions
doc-sanitize.summary: Published files ({docs}) on {host} contain internal metadata, hidden text/sheets, reversible redactions or incremental PDF revisions.

steps.title: Rewrite files cleanly without revisions or hidden layers
steps.action: Use FOCA-rs Preflight (`doc_clean`) to rewrite PDFs cleanly and strip OOXML/ODF/EXIF metadata; for bad redactions, rasterize or rebuild from sanitized source.

steps.title: Replace public file and purge CDN cache
steps.action: Publish the sanitized copy to {host} ({url}) and purge edge/proxy caches.

steps.title: Mandate pre-publication document hygiene check
steps.action: Require a clean Preflight hygiene check before external release and disable GPS tagging/incremental saves.

verify: Fetch {url} and confirm FOCA-rs Preflight reports hygiene grade >= B with zero revisions or hidden content.

doc-signature.title: Re-verify and re-sign modified or unverified signed documents
doc-signature.summary: Signed document ({docs}) exhibits post-signature edits, digest mismatch, TSA timestamp drift or exposed signer PII.

steps.title: Verify authoritative original against signing owner
steps.action: Retrieve the authoritative signed copy from DMS/archive; post-signature bytes invalidate integrity and audit trust.

steps.title: Re-sign sanitized final revision with valid TSA timestamp
steps.action: Produce a clean final copy of ({docs}), apply fresh signature + accredited TSA timestamp, and minimize exposed signer PII where policy permits.

verify: Confirm in signature verifier and FOCA-rs forensics that zero unsigned trailing modifications remain.

pii.title: Remove or anonymize exposed PII and GPS coordinates
pii.summary: Documents ({docs}) expose regulated personal data (tax IDs, cards, IBAN, contacts) or exact EXIF/XMP GPS coordinates.

steps.title: Restrict public access to files containing PII
steps.action: Remove unauthenticated public access at {url} or move the file behind authenticated access control.

steps.title: Strip GPS EXIF tags and mask PII before re-publishing
steps.action: Run FOCA-rs Preflight (`doc_clean`) to strip GPS EXIF metadata from images and mask/redact personal identifiers in documents.

verify: Re-analyze updated artifacts in FOCA-rs and verify 0 PII and 0 GPS detections.

tls-cert.title: Remediate TLS certificate or chain issue on {host}:{port}
tls-cert.summary: TLS certificate on {host}:{port} failed validation (expired, self-signed, incomplete chain, hostname/CAA mismatch or weak key/signature).

steps.title: Reissue certificate (RSA >= 2048 or ECDSA P-256, SHA-256) covering all SAN hostnames
steps.action: Provision a trusted CA/ACME certificate for {host}, align CAA records on {domain}, and omit internal PKI/LDAP URLs.

steps.title: Serve full intermediate chain and OCSP stapling
steps.action: Configure `fullchain.pem` (leaf + intermediates) in Nginx/HAProxy/Ingress and enable OCSP stapling and HTTP/2 ALPN.

verify: Run `openssl s_client -connect {host}:{port} -servername {host} -verify_return_error` and confirm `Verify return code: 0 (ok)`.

tls-crypto.title: Harden TLS protocol versions and cipher suites on {host}:{port}
tls-crypto.summary: Service at {host}:{port} negotiates deprecated TLS versions (1.0/1.1) or weak ciphers (RC4/3DES/EXPORT/anon).

steps.title: Restrict server to TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 only
steps.action: Set `ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;` (Mozilla Intermediate/Modern profile) on reverse proxy/load balancer and reload.

steps.title: Restrict cipher suites to AEAD with PFS (ECDHE + GCM/ChaCha20)
steps.action: Disable RC4, 3DES, NULL, EXPORT and static RSA suites; enable ECDHE AEAD cipher suites only.

verify: Confirm TLS 1.0/1.1 handshakes fail while TLS 1.2/1.3 succeed with ECDHE AEAD ciphers.

web-headers.title: Harden HTTP security headers, HSTS, CSP and cookie flags on {host}
web-headers.summary: Web application at {url} lacks security headers (HSTS, CSP, clickjacking protection), permits permissive CORS/cookies, or discloses exact server versions.

steps.title: Add Strict-Transport-Security, CSP frame-ancestors and hide server banners
steps.action: Add `Strict-Transport-Security`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, restrictive `Content-Security-Policy` (`frame-ancestors`) and disable `Server`/`X-Powered-By` banners.

steps.title: Harden Set-Cookie attributes and restrict CORS Allow-Origin
steps.action: Set `Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax` on session cookies and replace arbitrary Origin reflection or credentialed wildcards with an explicit origin allowlist.

verify: Run `curl -sI -H "Origin: https://evil.example" "{url}"` to verify HSTS, CSP and strict CORS rejection.

web-methods.title: Disable dangerous HTTP methods (TRACE/PUT/DELETE/WebDAV) on {host}
web-methods.summary: Web server {host} accepts or advertises unsafe HTTP methods (TRACE/PUT/DELETE) or WebDAV extensions.

steps.title: Restrict allowed HTTP methods and disable TRACE / WebDAV
steps.action: Disable `TraceEnable` and unused WebDAV handlers; whitelist only required methods per route via `limit_except` or gateway policy.

web-exposure.title: Block exposed backups, .git repositories, directory listings, source maps or public buckets on {host}
web-exposure.summary: Resource {url} exposes backups, DB dumps, `.git`, directory autoindexing, source maps or an open/dangling cloud bucket.

steps.title: Block public access and purge operational artifacts from webroot
steps.action: Delete backups, dumps, `.git` and `.map` files from webroot; deny dotfile patterns in proxy config, disable directory `autoindex`, and restrict bucket ACLs/policies.

steps.title: Rotate secrets if dumps, configs or .git were accessible externally
steps.action: Inspect access logs for {url} and rotate any DB/app credentials that may have resided in exposed dumps or `.git`.

verify: Confirm `curl -sI "{url}"` returns HTTP 403/404 and re-scan clears the finding.

dns-mail.title: Remediate DNS exposure and email authentication gaps on {domain}
dns-mail.summary: Host/domain {host} exhibits dangling CNAME (subdomain takeover), open AXFR zone transfer, NSEC walking, wildcard ambiguity or mail relay/PTR leaks.

steps.title: Remove dangling CNAME records, restrict AXFR transfers and switch to NSEC3
steps.action: Delete stale CNAME records pointing to unclaimed targets, restrict AXFR via TSIG/IP ACL, and migrate DNSSEC zones to NSEC3.

steps.title: Strip internal relay headers on outbound MTA and align PTR/A records
steps.action: Configure outbound mail gateway to sanitize internal `Received`/`X-Originating-IP` headers, enforce SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and align PTR records.

verify: Confirm `dig AXFR {domain}` returns refused/failed and `dig CNAME {host}` resolves validly or NXDOMAIN.

sw-cve.title: Patch vulnerable or end-of-life software (CISA KEV / CVE) on {host}
sw-cve.summary: Software versions observed on {host} or inside documents ({docs}) correspond to EOL releases or known exploited CVEs ({cve}).

steps.title: Verify exact deployed software version and backport status
steps.action: Confirm exact package/application version on {host} and endpoints, accounting for vendor backports before scheduling downtime.

steps.title: Apply security updates for {cve} or migrate off EOL components
steps.action: Upgrade affected components to supported releases, apply vendor patches for {cve}, and enforce compensating ACL/VPN isolation until patched.

verify: Confirm upgraded build on {host} resolves {cve} and re-scan with FOCA-rs to transition finding to Fixed.

ports-infra.title: Restrict exposed administrative ports or origin IP behind CDN on {host}
ports-infra.summary: Target {host} (port {port}) exposes management/DB ports publicly, reveals CDN origin IP directly, or leaks internal hosts/workstations.

steps.title: Restrict inbound firewall rules to VPN or CDN origin IP ranges
steps.action: Update host firewall / Security Group for {host}:{port} to permit connections solely from corporate VPN or verified CDN edge prefixes.

steps.title: Rotate compromised origin IP and enforce CDN Authenticated Origin Pulls
steps.action: Once firewall rules are active, rotate the exposed origin IP and enable mTLS between CDN edges and the origin.

verify: Verify external connection attempts to {host}:{port} outside VPN/CDN time out or are rejected.

internal-recon.title: Reduce internal topology exposure (RFC1918 IPs, UNC shares, AD usernames)
internal-recon.summary: Analyzed artifacts ({docs}) reveal internal IP addresses, hostnames, UNC/LNK paths, hardware MAC/serials, service accounts or predictable AD username patterns.

steps.title: Sanitize author names, UNC paths, data connections and LNK artifacts before export
steps.action: Strip document author fields, internal UNC paths, Excel external connections and avoid exposing `.lnk` shortcuts externally.

steps.title: Enforce MFA, lockout controls and least privilege on predictable/service accounts
steps.action: Because login/email templates are predictable externally, enforce MFA across VPN/SSO portals, enable smart lockout and restrict service account interactive logon.

verify: Re-check published documents with FOCA-rs Preflight and confirm MFA/lockout enforcement on external auth endpoints.

general.title: Triage and remediate security finding on {host}
general.summary: Finding detected on {host} (sources: {docs}). Validate impact in environment and apply least-privilege/exposure minimization controls.

steps.title: Validate asset ownership and confirm finding context
steps.action: Cross-check {host} ({url}) with asset inventory and update triage status (`confirmed` or `false`).

steps.title: Apply targeted remediation and record change
steps.action: Remediate root cause on {host} or source artifacts ({docs}) per the finding recommendation.

verify: Re-run FOCA-rs scan/analysis and verify the finding transitions to Fixed.
